title: From Request Fulfillers to Outcome Owners

pain.description: Name the pain leaders already feel: the request queue, slipping timelines, successful failures, IT as a black box.

cause.description: Why it happens: pulled in every direction, two competing systems, and treating enduring services like temporary projects.

shift.description: The shift from project to product, and proof that public organizations already work this way.

path.description: What changes for our people, how we make the transition, what we gain and what will be hard.
